display.title: Zayin Adar: Why Your Birthday Is a Special Day
display.summary_short: On Moshe Rabbeinu's yahrzeit and birthday, Uncle Yossi explains why a birthday is a joyful day in Heaven and on earth, and why every child should know their Hebrew birthday.
display.summary_long: A talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show in the week of Zayin Adar 5748. Uncle Yossi explains that the seventh of Adar is both the day Moshe Rabbeinu passed away and the day he was born. Haman chose Adar thinking it was only a sad month, but it is also a happy one. A birthday is a joyful day in Heaven, when a neshamah leaves Gan Eden to live a life of Torah and mitzvos, and on earth, because every new neshamah brings more light to the world and brings Moshiach closer. The Sages say a person's mazal is strong on his birthday, so it is a day to think, do teshuvah and make good resolutions toward Hashem, parents, teachers and friends. Your real birthday is your Hebrew date. He ends with a prayer that, as Haman's plan failed, Hashem cancel every harsh decree in the merit of Moshe Rabbeinu.
display.lesson: Your Hebrew birthday is a special day: a time to thank Hashem, do teshuvah and make resolutions to be better.
